column7: GET /api/v1/notifications returned every notification of the PAT owner to any restricted PAT, including ones naming secrets in projects outside the restriction ("You were granted read access to secret X"); the badge count and mark-read writes had the same reach. Fixed: a restricted PAT sees only notifications whose project it may secrets.read, none without a project (fail closed), and count/mark-read follow the same visibility. Found by PAT-GUARD-1's family sweep
